newsitem.title: FRANCE: ATHLETICS-GREEK PROTEST AFTER DEVERS GIVEN FINAL PLACE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-GREEK PROTEST AFTER DEVERS GIVEN FINAL PLACE.

text.p: The Greek Federation filed a protest after Olympic champion Gail Devers was given a place in the women's 60 metres final of the world indoor athletics championships ahead of Greek Ekaterini Thanou on Friday.
Devers, the American 100 metres Olympic champion, and Thanou had finished virtually level in second place in their semifinal, won by Russian Irina Privalova.
Both clocked 7.15 seconds but Devers was declared second, which enabled her to qualify for the final.
An official of the International Amateur Athletic Federation (IAAF) said a jury of appeals would consider the Greek protest before the final, scheduled later on Friday.
